mutation_targets.rationale: The permission matrix is the load-bearing constraint for authorization. Removing it allows Alloy to invent permissions that violate LeastPrivilege, e.g., allowing applicants to PATCH status or auditors to POST applications.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { Applicant -> PatchStatus in PermMatrix.allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact enforces that an application's assigned officer is always different from its applicant. Removing it lets Alloy create applications where assigned_officer = applicant, which the assertion should catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfAssignmentViolation { some app: LoanApplication | app.assigned_officer = app.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact prevents officers from generating audit entries where they transition an application they themselves submitted. Removing it allows audit entries violating the self-approval rule.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfApprovalViolation { some app: LoanApplication, ae: AuditEntry | ae.application = app and ae.actor = app.applicant and ae.actor_role = Officer }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact restricts transitions to the four legal ones (none→pending, pending→under_review, under_review→approved/rejected). Removing it allows invalid transitions like pending→approved or approved→under_review.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidTransition { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.previous_status = Approved and ae.new_status = UnderReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact ensures every application has at least one audit entry (the initial pending entry). Removing it creates applications with no audit trail, violating the completeness invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some app: LoanApplication | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.application = app }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact prevents duplicate audit entries (same app, status, actor). Removing it allows the same state transition to be recorded multiple times by the same actor, violating append-only semantics.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAudit { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.application = ae2.application and ae1.previous_status = ae2.previous_status and ae1.new_status = ae2.new_status and ae1.actor = ae2.actor }
